apple.subtitle: Zanzibar & Tanzania trip guide
apple.promotionalText: Explore Zanzibar and Tanzania on a real map, save your favourite places, shape an AI trip draft and find a season that suits your journey.
apple.description:
Find your way to Zanzibar and Tanzania with Destination Paradise.

EXPLORE ON A REAL MAP
Browse 24 destinations across Zanzibar and mainland Tanzania. Pan and zoom, filter by interests, search places and switch between the map and a photo list. Save favourites on your device and discover related excursions and safari experiences.

SHAPE YOUR TRIP
Choose your travel month, nights, group size, budget and pace. Start with a destination or a trip idea, then chat with the AI planner after giving your permission. Review the draft and decide whether to send your conversation and contact details to the Destination Paradise team for a quote. Suggestions are a starting point; the team confirms prices, availability and booking details.

CHOOSE YOUR SEASON
See current Zanzibar weather and a month-by-month seasonal guide. The weather scene follows the reported conditions, with a pause control and support for reduced motion.

GO A LITTLE DEEPER
Explore the island food guide and dates to know. Check venue and event details before making plans.

MADE FOR PHONES AND TABLETS
Enjoy a dark navy design, clear numbered map pins, phone destination sheets and a wider map-and-sidebar layout on tablets.

No account is required. Saved places and trip preferences stay on your device. Maps, photos, current weather and AI planning require an internet connection. External experience links open the website. The app does not provide turn-by-turn navigation or confirm bookings automatically.
